approval_gates.technical_evaluation_and_configuration: 用户明确委托 Codex 自行取得真实技术评测结果、如实登记并完成测试部署配置；不得将机器评测冒充真人交付评审或最终验收。

work_unit.title: 执行真实闭环、独立评审和 Outcome Owner 验收
work_unit.goal: 以完整自动化、真实飞书、真实 GitHub、故障恢复、独立技术评审和最终真人验收证明 G2 Production Closure。

external_prerequisites: A configured real Feishu test application using its authorized transport and an operable group or direct chat. Long connections do not produce HTTP challenge receipts.
A user-authorized GitHub test repository, encrypted connection Secret and branch on which one pull request may be created.

rules: Do not fabricate provider identifiers, human identities, Acceptance or review evidence.
Do not persist or log short-lived GitHub credentials or Feishu secrets.
The external pull request must converge to exactly one object and one matching EffectReceipt.
If acceptance exposes a product defect, stop this task and create a separately scoped fix packet.

commands: real Feishu and GitHub fault/restore runbook

required_items: real Feishu transport connection, inbound event, outbound reply and delivery identifiers; HTTP challenge only for webhook transport
real GitHub pull-request URL and matching EffectReceipt
API, Worker, Runner and provider fault/recovery timeline

stop_conditions: Any required automated gate fails after bounded diagnosis.
A provider secret or ephemeral credential appears in logs or durable facts.
The real GitHub operation creates more than one pull request.
The accepted Target cannot be reconstructed from PostgreSQL after restart.
Final human acceptance has not been explicitly recorded.
